summary: Regression test for SyntaxError fix in PortaleCliente.jsx. The AllegatoRow function declaration is correctly restored (line 683) and the file compiles cleanly. However, testing surfaced a DIFFERENT blocking runtime error: 'PenLine is not defined' in Sidebar.jsx — PenLine was referenced in ICON_MAP (line 73) but missing from the lucide-react import statement (lines 5-12). This crashed the entire React tree, showing a blank white page on ALL routes (not just /portale). Added PenLine to the Sidebar.jsx import; app now renders correctly. Verified /portale login works with marco.rossi@demo.it, dashboard renders, 'Le mie polizze' shows 2 PolizzaCards (INCENDIO POL-2026-00002 and RCA POL-2026-00001) without crashing. Neither test polizza is libro-matricola and the client has no allegati in seed data, so AllegatoRow could not be visually exercised, but its JSX is syntactically valid and the Titoli & Quietanze / Documenti & Upload pages that use it render without errors.
action_items: None — the reported SyntaxError is confirmed fixed. The additional missing-import bug (PenLine) in Sidebar.jsx was fixed by testing agent.
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar.jsx ICON_MAP references icons that must all be imported from lucide-react. Consider adding a lint rule / build check to catch missing imports referenced in ICON_MAP, since a single missing icon crashes the entire app with a blank page and no visible error overlay.

PortaleCliente.jsx is 1314 lines — should be split into smaller modules (LoginScreen, PolizzaCard, VeicoloRow, AllegatoRow, etc.) to prevent future accidental deletions during refactors like the one that caused this SyntaxError.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PortaleCliente SyntaxError fix verified. Test client marco.rossi@demo.it has 2 single polizze (no libro-matricola) and no attached allegati, so AllegatoRow rendering could not be visually confirmed with a live document — but the component compiles and containing pages render. If future testing needs to validate AllegatoRow rendering, seed data with a libro-matricola polizza + veicolo documents will be required.
rca of the issue: Root cause of blank white page: Sidebar.jsx used `PenLine` in ICON_MAP (line 73) but PenLine was not in the `import { ... } from 'lucide-react'` statement. This caused a ReferenceError at module evaluation time, which prevented React from mounting anything into #root. Reproduction: load any route → blank page, only console error 'PenLine is not defined'. Mitigation: added PenLine to the Sidebar.jsx lucide-react import list.
